events.verdict: Beasley's (DET) shot attempt does not make contact with the rim and the shot clock expires.
Thompson (DET) legally contests Herro's (MIA) jump shot, making "high-five" contact after the ball is released.
Adebayo (MIA) firms up in a screening position in Thompson's (DET) path and does not deliver contact as the two players come together.
Butler (MIA) reaches in and makes incidental contact with Cunningham's (DET) hand on the ball.
Butler (MIA) hooks his arm around Thompson's (DET) leg during the drive.
Duren (DET) moves alongside Butler's (MIA) path and avoids contact with his arms as he contests the driving shot attempt.
Hardaway Jr. (DET) comes together with Butler (MIA) during the switch and the two players briefly engage and separate.
Smith (MIA) is late to the spot and moving laterally when he initiates illegal contact with Cunningham (DET) that causes him to trip.
Cunningham (DET) closes out on Herro (MIA), who initiates the marginal contact during the jump shot attempt by extending his leg.
Beasley (DET) legally contests Herro's (MIA) jump shot attempt.
Butler (MIA) rolls to the basket and briefly engages with Hardaway Jr. (DET).
Butler (MIA) briefly has an arm around Duren (DET) as he defends through the contact during the screen.
Hardaway Jr. (DET) is retracting his arm into a vertical position and the contact with Butler's (MIA) arm during the shot attempt is marginal.
Adebayo (MIA) establishes himself in a screening position in Holland II's (DET) path and the two players briefly tangle arms.
Hardaway Jr. (DET) is off-balance when he comes together with Butler (MIA) during the rebound and the contact is marginal.
Robinson (MIA) commits a take foul on Cunningham (DET).
Hardaway Jr. (DET) requests and is awarded a timeout within five seconds of the ball at his disposal.
As Cunningham (DET) attempts to position his arm vertically, Butler (MIA) elevates into his shooting motion with his arm extended and the ensuing arm contact is marginal.
Cunningham (DET) impedes Butler (MIA) during the loose ball.
Duren (DET) legally contests Herro's (MIA) jump shot attempt.
